notes.title: Exciting Things Coming to ESCAPE SITE 13 in 2025!
notes.notes:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45158862/ca5c8865f3e0182d5a7aa4e1923420ebe70d9eef.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45158862/eba888625c0af9fa28302e0c1f6b41fd12f434c7.jpg[/img][/url]

Hey guys! We just want to say thank you for supporting us, it's hard out there for small indie titles, especially for SCP inspired ones, we appreciate every bit of support and love!

We will continue working on perfecting this game with bug fixes and constant updates, we hope to bring you a one of a kind experience.

There are exciting things coming to ES13 and Miwu Studio in 2025, stay tuned!
